summary.text: Ben Kramer is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 19 who has served since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner, he served in the House of Delegates from 2007 to 2019 and sits on the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kramer was born in Wheaton, Maryland, on March 5, 1957, attended Montgomery County public schools and John F. Kennedy High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in law enforcement from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 1979.
His legislative biography lists his occupation as a small business owner and operator.

Kramer served in the House of Delegates from 2007 to 2019, on the Judiciary Committee from 2007 to 2010 and the Economic Matters Committee from 2011 to 2019, where he chaired the Banking, Economic Development, Science, and Technology Subcommittee from 2015.
He was first elected to the Senate in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, on the Finance Committee.
He is a Deputy Majority Whip, Senate chair of the Joint Committee on Unemployment Insurance Oversight, and chair of the Montgomery County Senate Delegation.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
